requirement: CSS the agent writes on a WordPress site goes where the page loads it and is checked there: Tracy's design pages print Additional CSS, a custom_css write is read back on the home page, look.set refuses a page that prints none, page.look says whether a rule for an absent selector is loaded

oracle.invariant: S1: every built theme target hooks tracy_design_page_styles at wp_enqueue_scripts 100; on an artifact or fixture page it dequeues global-styles AND adds wp_custom_css_cb at wp_head 101; on a home or section page it does neither S2: a content.update of a custom_css post on WordPress is detected (type read before, or post_type in the call); a home page printing neither <style id="wp-custom-css"> nor the rule gives ok:true with warning ADDITIONAL_CSS_NOT_PRINTED and a next saying not to call it done (undo kept); a page carrying the rule answers additionalCss:printed with the receipt untouched; an unread page is additionalCss:unchecked S3: look.set on a page that prints none of a non-empty Additional CSS answers LOOK_SET_NOT_PRINTED, writes nothing, keeps no undo and names the last theme stylesheet the page loads; page.look with a selector no element matches says whether a stylesheet of the page holds a rule for it; the LOOK rules carry the not-printed and customer-named-file clauses and the check for CSS the page does not load
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
